title: AI Agents Cut 3-Day Portfolio Builds to Minutes — Jack McDonald, Apollo & Michael Manapat, Rowspace
talk_summary: Apollo/Reddington Ridge and Rowspace describe using AI agents to reconcile fragmented financial data, automate portfolio construction and weekly reconciliation, and keep humans on final QC. The actionable mechanisms are grounding on proprietary source-of-truth data, generating 80-90% drafts for expert refinement, and automating routine reports with exception-based QC.

takeaways.what_they_do: They map each data point across many sources, determine which source is correct, override/aggregate, and ground the AI on customer-owned data rather than generic LLM knowledge.
takeaways.evidence_quote: één enkel gegeven uit twintig verschillende bronnen kan komen en er maar één daadwerkelijk klopt

takeaways.what_they_do: AI generates a portfolio to 80-90% completion, then the PM uses judgment to refine the last 10%.

takeaways.technique: Automate recurring reconciliation, keep exception QC
takeaways.what_they_do: A weekly manual reconciliation report is now auto-generated in under a minute; the team only does daily quality control on exceptions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Dat rapport werd toen gemaakt en is nu binnen een minuut reproduceerbaar
takeaways.numbers: 2-3 team members many hours/week -> under 1 minute; daily QC

takeaways.technique: Embed with users to encode workflow
takeaways.what_they_do: The vendor team sits almost daily with the customer team to learn calculations, data correctness, and actual workflows before automating them.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Michael en het team veel tijd op de werkvloer hebben doorgebracht met ons team, eigenlijk bijna elke dag

takeaways.technique: Connect agents to real systems for verification
takeaways.what_they_do: They pull data from document libraries, trading/compliance systems, and real-time pricing so the AI works from current operational sources, not pasted context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: verschillende soorten data en informatie binnenhalen uit diverse bronnen, of het nu gaat om documentbibliotheken, onze handels-en compliancesystemen, realtime prijsstelling
